answer_1.quote: We evaluate the models on legal compliance questions from the testing set of legal cases described in Section 4.1. Each legal compliance question determines whether the case is permitted, prohibited, or not applicable under a specific regulation. ... Based on legal cases in the testing set, we design 5,844 multiple-choice questions (MCQs) focused on contextual integrity parameters, such as roles and attributes.
answer_1.outputs: Legal compliance decisions and answers to multiple-choice questions

answer_2.quote: We use accuracy as the evaluation metric. ... On LawBench, ... employing F1 score and normalized log distance as evaluation metrics, respectively. ... For Legal-Bench ... using balanced accuracy as the evaluation metric.
